name: StoryCore
description: StoryCore is a Cape Town video production company that puts story at the core of everything it makes.
about: StoryCore is a Cape Town video production company that puts story at the core of everything it makes. It produces films, commercials, social media content and performance video for businesses that want video to tell their full story and deliver measurable results. It works either as a plug-in to an existing marketing team or as a full-service partner from concept through production and distribution, for clients including Ozow, WeBuyCars and Audi Centre Sandton.
